{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-2cgt","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-636h.3: SX1262.cs ReaderLoop DispatchMessage can silently die (P3)","description":"File: .extraction/renode-lora-peripherals/peripherals/sx126x/SX1262.cs:723

DispatchMessage(resp) is called from ReaderLoop without a try/catch. If DispatchMessage throws (e.g., IndexOutOfRangeException from a malformed simulator message), the exception propagates to ReaderLoop catch (Exception) { break; } at line 710, which exits the reader loop. No error is logged.

Impact: Subsequent RX_PACKET/TX_DONE notifications from the simulator are lost. TX operations write to a live socket but receive no responses, leaving the simulated radio in an inconsistent state.

Fix: Wrap DispatchMessage(resp) in a try/catch that logs the error and continues the loop instead of breaking.","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T16:00:19.593004423Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T16:00:19.593004423Z"}
